description: (needs account token) Starts moving a domain registered here to another registrar. Auto-renew goes off and the transfer code is emailed to the account within a day. The domain keeps working until it moves. confirm=true applies it. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

domain.description: Optional: which domain of that site. Default: its main domain.

site.description: The address of the site the domain belongs to, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: transfer_domain_out
title: Transfer domain out
